name: Hookup Tails
source:
Your hometown was never your true destination, but today you're happy you're back for a visit. A perky vixen from your past is drinking at your old watering hole, and this fox is happy to reconnect! Will you wow her with your charm and get her to take you home, or will you overplay your hand and get shown the door? 

[From [url=https://sharkhound.itch.io/hookup-tails]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的家乡从来都不是你真正的目的地，但今天你很高兴能回来参观。你过去的一只活泼的泼妇正在你的老水坑里喝酒，这只狐狸很高兴能重新建立联系！你会用你的魅力让她惊叹并让她带你回家，还是你会表现得过分而被赶出家门？

[来自[url=https://sharkhound.itch.io/hookup-tails]Itch.io[/url]]
